iteration_1_findings: Fence read as round log barricades rather than the reference's dense pointed palisade.
Large round snow caps read as marshmallow discs instead of thin pointed frosting.
Hanging blue/orange lantern assemblies were too industrial and visually dominant.
T03 lane tint remained broader/darker than the clean T02 work-floor treatment.
iteration_2_findings: Palisade silhouette was much closer, but snow frosting covered too little of the pointed crown.
Picket gaps remained wider than the reference.
Rear rails were too dark/thick and competed with the vertical fence rhythm.
Gate markers still read as dark square boxes rather than quiet integrated threshold details.
iteration_3_findings: Snow crown intersected the brown picket point and rendered as a white outline around a brown triangle.
Gate-post dark bands visually merged into a black block at gameplay scale.
Two visible rear rails still competed with the reference's vertical palisade rhythm.
iteration_4_findings: Exact-source closeups showed a brown stripe cutting through the intended snow crown.
Fence timber remained more saturated orange than the pale salmon/brown reference fence.
Gate threshold warmth was acceptable but should stay even quieter.
iteration_5_findings: Fence silhouette and snow crowns were close to reference, but the open gate leaves were still swung picket-fence panels.
The authoritative reference uses solid framed warm timber gate leaves with diagonal bracing.
iteration_6_findings: North-main framed leaves were too close to edge-on in normal gate views and could read as missing rather than intentionally open.
West-work gate showed a visible hinge/fence alignment seam in the affected visual group.
C6 passed after correcting its response-contract defect; preserve that performance proof because iteration 7 does not change mesh, material, batch count, physics or population.
iteration_7_findings: C1/C2 north-work gates passed after iteration-7 visual re-angle; the edge-on/missing-leaf and hinge seam defects are closed.
C1 lanes and conditions passed; the earlier dark-asphalt lane finding was critic misattribution to foreign task pads.
C1 river-gates failed because authoritative-length leaves remained too edge-on/distant to read as intentional framed future-crossing gates.
C2 palisade failed on visible panel joins and the recessed support rail reading as a ground-line artifact; C1 palisade style itself passed exactly.

The reference palisade is dominated by vertical snow-capped pickets; a strong exposed horizontal rail materially weakens that read.

iteration_8b_repair.performance_domain: No triangle/material/shader/draw-batch/physics/animation/NPC increase; corrected iteration-6 C6 proof remains preserved.

iteration_8b_findings: The support rail remained visibly continuous through the fence closeup even after depth recession.
